title: A_CustomItem
description: A_CustomItem is a plugin to save your item with all their data to save them into a menu.
body:
# A_CustomItem
Made by **[Ashborn Studio](https://ashborn.online)** with **[VisualBukkit](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/visual-bukkit.76474/)**

Made for everyone who need to store item for future use

---

## ⚙️ How it works
### Commands
- `/customitem` -> Open the GUI.
- `/customitem addHand` -> Add the item in your hand.
  - `/customitem addHand root` -> Add the item in your hand in the root of the save.
  - `/customitem addHand current` -> Add the item in your hand in the last opened category.
### Interface
- Slot 1 to 45 : Show items and categories.
- Slot 50 : Information item.
- Slot 48 and 52 : Change page.
- Slot 51 : Create category.
- Slot 49 : Go back (category).

## Features
- Opening the menu with all saved item.
- Adding the current item in main hand.
- Classify your items.

## 📦 Dependancy
- No external dependency needed

## ⚠️ Know issue
- Not really an issue but **everthing is in french**, the multi-language support will be in the version 1.0.0 !
